result.quote: with which Abimelech hired some worthless and reckless men to follow him.
result.reason: The action is correctly identified as hiring men, but the window describes them as “worthless and reckless,” not “wicked and violent.” In particular, “violent” is not established; the following murder is attributed to Abimelech. The supported answer is: He hired worthless and reckless men to follow him.
